description: This file defines the SiteSettingsDeploymentSource class, which extends DeploymentSourceBase to process site settings deployment steps by retrieving site settings asynchronously and adding selected settings to a deployment result.

classes.name: SiteSettingsDeploymentSource
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for creating deployment data for site settings based on specified deployment steps.

methods.name: ProcessAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a deployment step by retrieving site settings and adding selected properties to the deployment result.
